dialogues.jp: ４月になり、本格的な春が訪れた。
dialogues.en: I'm glad the boring ceremony is over.
dialogues.text: I'm glad the boring ceremony is over.

dialogues.jp:
桜も咲き乱れ（これは年中か）、すっかり温か
くなった。
dialogues.en: During the first week, all the classes end before noon.
dialogues.text: During the first week, all the classes end before noon.

dialogues.jp: 俺も本校に進学した。
dialogues.en: Today, too, all we have left are homeroom activities.
dialogues.text: Today, too, all we have left are homeroom activities.

dialogues.jp: 入学式は７日に行われた。
dialogues.en: "I like it when we have no classes."
dialogues.text: "I like it when we have no classes."

dialogues.jp:
今さら、本校の入学式なんて、緊張するわけも
なく、そつなく終わった。
dialogues.en: "I agree, but homeroom is so boring."
dialogues.text: "I agree, but homeroom is so boring."

dialogues.jp: 最初の一週間くらいは半ドンらしい。
dialogues.en: "Can I make it interesting then?"
dialogues.text: "Can I make it interesting then?"

dialogues.jp:
今日も、連絡事項などのＨＲがあっただけで、
後は帰りのＨＲを残すだけになった。
dialogues.en: "Knock it off."
dialogues.text: "Knock it off."

dialogues.jp:
建物の構造も大して変わらなければ、クラス編
成もほとんど付属の時と変わらない。
dialogues.en:
Nothing seems different. The campus buildings, classroom
assignments -- almost everything seems the same.
dialogues.text:
Nothing seems different. The campus buildings, classroom
assignments -- almost everything seems the same.

dialogues.jp:
男子は制服すらほとんど一緒なんだから、女子
に比べて、よけいそんな感じだ。
dialogues.en: Boys wear exactly the same uniform as before.
dialogues.text: Boys wear exactly the same uniform as before.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ほら、みんな席についてー！　帰りのＨＲ始
　めるよー」
dialogues.en: "All right, guys, take your seats. Let's get started."
dialogues.text: "All right, guys, take your seats. Let's get started."

dialogues.jp: ガタガタと騒がしかった教室が、一気に静まる。
dialogues.en: All of a sudden, the class becomes quiet.
dialogues.text: All of a sudden, the class becomes quiet.

dialogues.jp:
新入生だからか、去年より静かになるのが早い
気がする。
dialogues.en: It seems the freshmen are quite submissive.
dialogues.text: It seems the freshmen are quite submissive.

dialogues.jp: ＨＲも明日の連絡をして、さっさと終わる。
dialogues.en: The homeroom was done quickly with announcements.
dialogues.text: The homeroom was done quickly with announcements.

dialogues.jp:
鞄に詰めるモノもほとんどないのだから、楽な
もんだ。
dialogues.en: I've got almost nothing to carry in my bag.
dialogues.text: I've got almost nothing to carry in my bag.

dialogues.jp:
教室でだべる者、さっさと帰る者、これもすっ
かり見慣れた日常の景色だ。
dialogues.en:
Some students keep chatting, while others leave the room.
Nothing seems different.
dialogues.text:
Some students keep chatting, while others leave the room.
Nothing seems different.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「おーい、朝倉。ちょっと来てくれ」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Asakura, can you come over here for a minute?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Asakura, can you come over here for a minute?"

dialogues.jp: 教卓のそばにいた暦先生が、手招きで俺を呼ぶ。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei asks me to come to her desk.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei asks me to come to her desk.

dialogues.jp: 「なんですか？　先生」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「あのさ、天枷、今日学校に来てるってさ」
dialogues.en: "Miharu Amakase came to school today."
dialogues.text: "Miharu Amakase came to school today."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ホ、ホントですか？」
dialogues.en: "Re-Really?"
dialogues.text: "Re-Really?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「あたしがウソ言ってどうするの。本当だよ。
　春休み中に目が覚めてね、ようやくリハビリ
　も終わったらしい」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah. She regained consciousness during the spring break,
and already finished her rehab."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah. She regained consciousness during the spring break,
and already finished her rehab."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「元気でしたか？」
dialogues.en: "Is she okay?"
dialogues.text: "Is she okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「あたしはまだ会ってないけどね。人づての話
　だと元気だってさ」
dialogues.en: "I haven't seen her yet. But I heard she's fine."
dialogues.text: "I haven't seen her yet. But I heard she's fine."

dialogues.jp: そうか、元気になったのか……。
dialogues.en: Wow... she's back...
dialogues.text: Wow... she's back...

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「もしかして、複雑な気分にさせちゃった？」
dialogues.en: "I hope I'm not confusing your feelings..."
dialogues.text: "I hope I'm not confusing your feelings..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「あ、別にそんなことないですって。大丈夫で
　すよ、その辺は」
dialogues.en: "Uh... Not at all. I'm fine."
dialogues.text: "Uh... Not at all. I'm fine."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「なら、いいんだけど」
dialogues.en: "Okay. Good to know."
dialogues.text: "Okay. Good to know."

dialogues.jp:
あれから、それほど時間が経ってるわけじゃな
いけど、ずっと前の話のような気がする。
dialogues.en: It hasn't been that long, but I feel like it was ages ago.
dialogues.text: It hasn't been that long, but I feel like it was ages ago.

dialogues.jp:
けど、俺の中に思い出がある限り、俺はあいつ
とずっと一緒だ。
dialogues.en: As long as I have her in my memory, I am with her.
dialogues.text: As long as I have her in my memory, I am with her.

dialogues.jp:
たとえ、俺がどんなに変わってしまったとして
も、それだけはずっと変わらない。
dialogues.en:
No matter how much I change, these feelings will never
change.
dialogues.text:
No matter how much I change, these feelings will never
change.

dialogues.jp: 俺は美春の知っているままの俺なのだ。
dialogues.en: I am who I am -- the me who Miharu knows.
dialogues.text: I am who I am -- the me who Miharu knows.

dialogues.jp: 美春もまた、俺の知っているままの美春なのだ。
dialogues.en: And Miharu is who Miharu is -- the Miharu who I know.
dialogues.text: And Miharu is who Miharu is -- the Miharu who I know.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、気をつけて帰りな」
dialogues.en: "Take care."
dialogues.text: "Take care."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「はい、ありがとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Thank you, ma'am."
dialogues.text: "Thank you, ma'am."

dialogues.jp: 毎日通るこの道を今日も歩いて帰る。
dialogues.en: I walk home on the same way as always.
dialogues.text: I walk home on the same way as always.

dialogues.jp: いつもと変わらない景色。
dialogues.en: The same views I get as always.
dialogues.text: The same views I get as always.

dialogues.jp: 相変わらず、舞い散り続ける桜。
dialogues.en:
The cherry blossom petals are dancing around in the wind as
always.
dialogues.text:
The cherry blossom petals are dancing around in the wind as
always.

dialogues.jp: 見慣れた下校風景。
dialogues.en: The same scene I see on the way home every day.
dialogues.text: The same scene I see on the way home every day.

dialogues.jp: いつもと同じように見えても、実は違う。
dialogues.en: In reality, however, nothing remains the same.
dialogues.text: In reality, however, nothing remains the same.

dialogues.jp: 変わっていると思うかどうかは自分次第だ。
dialogues.en: It's up to me how I see these things.
dialogues.text: It's up to me how I see these things.

dialogues.jp:
同じ繰り返しも、まったく同じと感じるかどう
かは自分次第。
dialogues.en:
It's up to me whether things are just the same pattern
recurring over and over again.
dialogues.text:
It's up to me whether things are just the same pattern
recurring over and over again.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「せんぱ〜い」
dialogues.en: "Sempaiiiiii!"
dialogues.text: "Sempaiiiiii!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉せんぱ〜い」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sempai!"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sempai!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「せんぱ〜い、おひさしぶりですぅ〜」
dialogues.en: "Sempai, long time no see!"
dialogues.text: "Sempai, long time no see!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「美春！　美春じゃないか！　なんだ、元気そ
　うだなあ！」
dialogues.en: "Miharu! Wow, you look great!"
dialogues.text: "Miharu! Wow, you look great!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「はい、おかげさまで〜！　先輩、一緒に帰り
　ましょう、チョコバナナでも食べながら」
dialogues.en:
"Thanks. How about we go home together and eat chocolate
bananas?"
dialogues.text:
"Thanks. How about we go home together and eat chocolate
bananas?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「よっしゃ、今日は復帰祝いに、俺が｛おご／奢｝ってや
　る」
dialogues.en: "Sure! It's on me then -- a present for your discharge!"
dialogues.text: "Sure! It's on me then -- a present for your discharge!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「わ！　わ！　マジですかぁ？　やったァ！」
dialogues.en: "Wow! Really? Hooray!!"
dialogues.text: "Wow! Really? Hooray!!"

dialogues.jp:
また、いつもと変わらない、新しい毎日が始ま
ろうとしていた。
dialogues.en: A new day has begun -- as always.
dialogues.text: A new day has begun -- as always.

dialogues.jp: ――ざざん
dialogues.en: Whoosh...
dialogues.text: Whoosh...

dialogues.jp:
年がら年中、花を咲かせている桜の樹が、風に
揺れた。
dialogues.en:
The cherry tree, which is in full bloom throughout the year,
shakes in the wind.
dialogues.text:
The cherry tree, which is in full bloom throughout the year,
shakes in the wind.

dialogues.jp: ◆ＥＤ・新しい毎日◆
dialogues.en: ◆It's April, and spring is here.◆
dialogues.text: ◆It's April, and spring is here.◆

dialogues.jp:
『美春』が学校に復帰した。美春はもういない
けれど、俺の中に思い出がある限り、俺は美春
とずっと一緒だ。
dialogues.en: With the cherry blossoms in full boom, it's getting warm.
dialogues.text: With the cherry blossoms in full boom, it's getting warm.

dialogues.jp:
そして『美春』と一緒にチョコバナナを食べな
がら帰る。
dialogues.en: I now study on the main campus.
dialogues.text: I now study on the main campus.

dialogues.jp:
また、いつもと変わらない、新しい毎日が始ま
ろうとしていた。
dialogues.en: Yesterday was our entrance ceremony.
dialogues.text: Yesterday was our entrance ceremony.
